import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic.{reducible, simp}

def singleDigitPrimeFactor (n : Nat) : Nat :=
  if (n > 0) then
    (if (n = 1) then 0 else 1)
  else 0

theorem singleDigitPrimeFactor_spec_satisfied (n : Nat) (h_precond : singleDigitPrimeFactor_precond (n)) :
  singleDigitPrimeFactor (n) h_precond = singleDigitPrimeFactor (n) h_precond ∧
  singleDigitPrimeFactor (n) h_precond = singleDigitPrimeFactor (n) h_precond
